Package domain.model

Class Hexagon

java.lang.Object
domain.model.Hidato
domain.model.Hexagon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Hexagon extends Hidato
Represents a Hidato board with hexagonal cells. This class handles the specific adjacency logic for hexagons in a vertical presentation.

  • Method Details

    • getAdjacents

      public Collection<int[]> getAdjacents(int r, int c)
      Calculates the adjacent cells for a given hexagonal cell. In a vertical presentation, even rows (0, 2, ...) and odd rows (1, 3, ...) have different adjacency patterns due to the staggered offset. * @param r The row index of the cell.
      Specified by:
      getAdjacents in class Hidato
      Parameters:
      r - Row index.
      c - The column index of the cell.
      Returns:
      A collection of integer arrays, where each array contains the [row, col] of an adjacent cell.
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the provided row or column is outside the board dimensions.
